name: La Lolat Eco Camp
amenities: Bamboo stilt huts, Home-cooked Mishing fish thali, Bicycle rentals, Bonfire
description: Authentic traditional bamboo cottage experience built on stilts over water hyacinth ponds. Run by local youth promoting Mishing tribal arts.

name: Diphlu River Lodge Homestay Annex
amenities: Tea garden view, Organic Assamese meals, Guided birdwatching, Safari booking assistance
description: Charming family-run lodge tucked next to tea gardens. Host Bhaben is an accredited naturalist with 20 years of wildlife tracking experience.

name: Serene Homestay Nongriat
amenities: Dormitory and private rooms, Fresh mountain stream bath, Khasi vegetarian/pork meals, Free walking sticks
description: Located just 3 minutes walk from the Double Decker Living Root Bridge. Clean, simple, and the warmest Khasi family hospitality you will ever experience.

name: Betelnut Eco Huts
amenities: Riverside wooden huts, Bonfire, Kayaking gear, Traditional Khasi and Jaintia meals
description: Step directly from your bamboo porch onto the white pebble shores of the crystalline Umngot River.

name: Dungkar Monpa Homestay
amenities: Wood-fired Bukhari heater, Butter tea & Momos, Mountain view rooms, Prayer room access
description: Cosy Monpa home with panoramic view of Tawang Monastery. Host Tsering serves piping hot thukpa and shares fascinating folk stories of the Himalayan passes.

name: Abotani Traditional Bamboo Cottage
amenities: Apatani hearth room, Rice wine tasting, Organic garden veggies, Walking tour with village elder
description: Experience living in an authentic Apatani wooden stilt house in Hong, the largest Apatani village. Watch sunset over green paddy fields.

name: Viswema Trekkers Nest
amenities: Camp tents, Sleeping bags rental, Warm water bucket, Naga smoked pork stew, Trail guide
description: The base camp homestay for Dzukou trekkers. Viketou provides sleeping bags, mats, and guides for the early morning ascent.

name: Meru Eco Homestay
amenities: Handcrafted Angami wood interior, Terrace farm view, Traditional weaving demo, Birding guide
description: Perched right above ancient terrace fields. Host Kevichusa is an active member of the Khonoma Green Village Council.

name: Phumdi Floating Homestay
amenities: Wooden cabin on floating Phumdi island, Canoe ride included, Fresh lake fish dinner, Solar power
description: A once-in-a-lifetime experience: sleep in a bamboo eco-hut floating on Loktak Lake! Watch sunrise over misty water while lotus flowers open.

name: Reiek Community Tourist Huts
amenities: Traditional Mizo bamboo cottage, Pine valley view, Fresh Bai stew, Walking distance to peak
description: Operated by the village community cooperative. Spectacular cool breezes and uninterrupted starry night skies.

name: Unakoti Heritage Retreat
amenities: Spacious garden rooms, Authentic Tripuri cuisine (Mui Borok), Tea garden walk, Guided cave visits
description: Surrounded by betel nut groves and tea estates. Biplab arranges early-morning visits to Unakoti before tour buses arrive.

name: Kanchenjunga View Homestay
amenities: Direct Kanchenjunga sunrise from bed, Organic Lepcha/Bhutia meals, Hot water geyser, Fireplace
description: Panoramic sunrise views without leaving your bedroom. Dawa and his family serve home-grown organic vegetable soups, momos, and Sikkim tea.
